description: This file defines a factory function for creating instances of ServerManagerService within the rialto::servermanager::service namespace. It includes utility functions for permission conversion and references external classes and configurations related to server management.

methods.name: convertSocketPermissions
methods.description: Converts SocketPermissions object to an unsigned int permission mask, defaulting if out of bounds.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory function that creates and returns a unique pointer to an IServerManagerService instance, configured with provided parameters.
